now.title: X-Men '97
now.text: In episode 7, Sebastian Shaw, now on Genosha's council, dies in the Sentinel attack, while Emma Frost survives in diamond form.

proposed.text: In episode 5, Sebastian Shaw, now on Genosha's council, dies in the Sentinel attack, while Emma Frost survives in diamond form.

changes.evidence: Sebastian Shaw (Earth-92131) is killed by the Wild Sentinel in the attack on Genosha in X-Men '97 Season 1 episode 5 ('Remember It'); Death field = X-Men '97 Season 1 5. Episode 7 ('Bright Eyes') is the aftermath and funeral, not the attack.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 6, Sabretooth stalks Wolverine and clashes with the X-Men again and again.

proposed.text: In episode 4, Xavier tries to reach his better nature, but Sabretooth turns on the X-Men.

changes.evidence: Records are out of order: k0 is tagged episode 6 ('Cold Vengeance', Arctic attack on Wolverine) but k1 is episode 4 ('Deadly Reunions', Xavier's therapy fails and Sabretooth attacks Jubilee). Swap the two texts so episode 4 comes first; no wording changed.

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 4, Xavier tries to reach his better nature, but Sabretooth turns on the X-Men.

proposed.text: In episode 6, Sabretooth stalks Wolverine and clashes with the X-Men again and again.

changes.evidence: Second half of the swap: episode 6 ('Cold Vengeance') follows episode 4 ('Deadly Reunions').

now.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
now.text: In episode 66, she serves Apocalypse in his plot against time. Later her son Graydon Creed kidnaps her to trap Nightcrawler.

proposed.text: In episode 59, she serves Apocalypse in his plot against time. Later her son Graydon Creed kidnaps her to trap Nightcrawler.

changes.evidence: The record's last event (Graydon Creed kidnaps Mystique to lure Nightcrawler) is in 'Bloodlines', episode 59 in the list numbering, not episode 66 (Beyond Good and Evil Part 4, eps 63-66). Bloodlines aired Oct 26, 1996, after Beyond Good and Evil (Nov 1995), so the 'Later' order is right; only the episode tag must be the last episode covered, 59.

proposed.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
proposed.text: In episode 13, after Master Mold turns on its makers, the X-Men capture Gyrich and force him to reveal where it is. He then flees with Trask to avoid prosecution.

changes.evidence: In 'The Final Decision' (episode 13) Master Mold goes rogue; Gyrich is captured by the X-Men and forced to reveal the second Master Mold's location, after which he and Trask flee North America to avoid prosecution. The file has no record for this capture. (FX-001 The Master Mold Uprising, now on the episode 51 record, may belong here instead; left for the owner to judge.)

owner_calls.question: k5 (X-Men: The Last Stand) has status Deceased, but the Brotherhood is not wiped out: Magneto is depowered by the cure and is last seen free in a San Francisco park, Pyro is subdued, Juggernaut stopped. Which status should the group end on?
owner_calls.evidence: Plot: Iceman subdues Pyro, Hank McCoy injects Magneto with the cure; later Magneto sits at a chessboard in San Francisco, seemingly human, and a chess piece wobbles.

owner_calls.question: k3 (X-Men '97 season 2) has status Deceased, but the record says Rogue frees Gambit (who rejoins the X-Men) and traps Apocalypse's mind in a crystal; only War is dead. Which status should the group end on?
owner_calls.evidence: Survival of the Fittest (ep 19): Rogue frees Gambit and the others and traps Apocalypse's consciousness inside a crystal she gives to Cable. War was executed in ep 12.
